claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Propylthiouracil at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells directly; its known pharmacology is inhibition of thyroid peroxidase and type I iodothyronine deiodinase, and any antiproliferative effect would require much higher concentrations or prolonged exposure, so the pooled screen is expected to show little or no cytotoxicity.
